incoming.name: Optical microscope
incoming.excerpt: These multi-component lenses are designed to reduce aberrations, particularly chromatic aberration and spherical aberration.

outgoing.name: Microscope
outgoing.excerpt: The use of achromats was an important step in the development of the optical microscope.

outgoing.name: Photography
outgoing.excerpt: The term " purple fringing" is commonly used in photography, although not all purple fringing can be attributed to chromatic aberration.
